name: Load Models
description: A diffusion model with its text encoder and VAE, picked from your model folders, as one model for Text Encode, Sampler and VAE Encode. A model that reads a file of its own (MOSS Image's Qwen3.5 tokenizer) gets it from Get ready.

inputs.name: text_encoder
inputs.label: Text encoder
inputs.description: The language model the diffusion model reads prompts with: Qwen3 4B for Z-Image Turbo and FLUX.2 Klein 4B, Qwen3 8B for Klein 9B; UMT5 for Wan; T5 (t5xxl) for FLUX.1, SD3 and Chroma.

inputs.name: clip_l
inputs.label: CLIP-L
inputs.description: FLUX.1 (Dev, Fill, Kontext) reads a CLIP-L encoder beside its T5, which goes in Text encoder. Leave empty for the other models.

inputs.name: clip_g
inputs.label: CLIP-G
inputs.description: SD3 and SD3.5 read a CLIP-G encoder (1280 wide) beside CLIP-L and T5. Leave empty for the other models.

inputs.name: clip_vision
inputs.label: CLIP vision
inputs.description: Wan 2.1 image-to-video (and first-last-frame) reads a CLIP vision model (clip_vision_h) to see its start picture. Leave empty for the other models.

inputs.name: high_noise_diffusion_model
inputs.label: High-noise diffusion model
inputs.description: Wan 2.2 14B makes a clip with two diffusion models: this one for the first, noisiest steps, and the Diffusion model for the rest.
